title: Zoning text change for 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This application establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens, paired with a related zoning map change. Together the actions would allow a new 10-story mixed-use building with about 76 apartments, 19 of them income-restricted. The City Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026 and the Land Use Committee recommended approval with modifications on September 24, 2026.
